consts.name: dmdInsultSubjectsCount
consts.comment: the insult subjects count - comments about a person honor, courage, dislikes, fears, family, dress, behavior, friends, and even possessions can be cause for insult, nine subjects (print capture p. 312)

consts.name: dmdIgnorableJestInsults
consts.comment: the ignorable jest insults - truly generous people might ignore one or two insults spoken in jest, but no more (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdExtraordinarilyPolite
bools.comment: the extraordinarily polite - the people of Kara-Tur, as noticed by the gajin, extraordinarily polite as a rule, going to meticulous pains to behave in the correct manner (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdMannersAsCrime
bools.comment: the manners as crime - among the higher classes incorrect or poor manners virtually as great a crime as murder, severe punishments for those who knowingly or unknowingly commit a social faux pas (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdClassMarkersAndRidicule
bools.comment: the class markers and ridicule - correct manners mark the differences between social classes and help prevent embarrassing oneself in public, there being no greater sin than to be laughed at by others (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdHonorRidiculeMechanic
bools.comment: the honor ridicule mechanic - the concern over insults to honor and the risk of public ridicule prompts the politeness; the DM may cause player characters to lose honor when they would bring themselves ridicule, characters cannot be cavalier in their attitude (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdBowMeasuresRespect
bools.comment: the bow measures respect - the bow the most obvious expression of manners, not just a way of saying Hello, it measures the respect one has for the person bowed to (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdLowerBowsDeeper
bools.comment: the lower bows deeper - those of lower status bow lower to their superiors than their superiors do to them, a high ranking official perhaps barely nodding to those under him (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdKowtowDeference
bools.comment: the kowtow deference - the greatest deference is the kowtow, kneeling and touching the head to the floor, normally done only in the presence of emperors and extremely powerful lords, sometimes necessary when apologizing or begging forgiveness (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdKowtowExtremeAct
bools.comment: the kowtow extreme act - except in the presence of a powerful lord, kowtowing is an extreme act, representing the debasement and surrender of the person to another (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdWordsCanInsult
bools.comment: the words can insult - manners extend to what one says; statements, even spoken in jest, can be insulting and offensive (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdInsultsSeldomLight
bools.comment: the insults seldom light - insults are seldom taken lightly, even the generous unable to abide more than a jest or two (print capture p. 312)

bools.name: dmdPoliteConversation
bools.comment: the polite conversation - to prevent insults, conversations are often stilted or phrased in extremely polite terms to avoid offence (print capture p. 312)
